content:
Lucy: FYI I'm prepping the internal announce for v3.0.0 (staging deploy tonight). Need a tiny RN blurb + embargo window. Can we pin staging at 23:50 UTC?

Jorge: Draft RN: "v3.0.0: improved KV cache eviction to reduce tail latency; telemetry additions and doc links. No API changes." Short and sweet.

Mia: Agree. Add one line about expected impact: "p95 latency expected down ~100ms on short prompts in most workloads."

Owen: Risk: cache eviction could touch long-seq jobs. Rollback plan in runbook: auto-fallback to v2.9.9 if 5xx > 0.4% for 5m OR error spike on long-seq > 2x baseline. Owner: @owen.

QA-bot: Smoke tests available: `smoke/kv_cache_smoke` and `smoke/long_seq_regression`. Run command: `./bin/ci-run smoke kv_cache_smoke`

Lucy: deploy-bot, please schedule staging at 2026-03-25T23:55:00Z, canary 5% -> 25% at +10m -> 100% at +45m if healthy. Pin until 01:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: v3.0.0 -> staging @ 2026-03-25T23:55:00Z. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% @ +10m -> 100% @ +45m. Staging pin applied until 2026-03-26T01:00:00Z. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/v3-deploys

Jorge: Internal announce snippet: "[INTERNAL] Rolling v3.0.0 to staging 23:55 UTC. Primary: KV cache eviction improvements reducing p95 for short prompts. No API changes. Canary + staged rollout; watch p95 and 5xx. Owners: @owen (rollback), @mia (qa), @lucy (comm). Report issues in #oncall."

Mia: Quick QA note to internal announce: "Please run smoke/kv_cache_smoke and spot-check long-seq pipelines. Commands in the thread."

Owen: I'll set up a short dashboard and a temporary alert rule: if staging 5xx > 0.4% for 5m OR long_seq error-rate > 2x baseline for 10m -> trigger auto-rollback. Also manual rollback step: `/deploy rollback --env staging --to v2.9.9`

Lucy: Can we add an embargo line? Legal asked to hold external RN until 2026-03-26 09:00 UTC (APAC window). So internal announce only now.

Jorge: Add to internal ann: "External release embargo until 2026-03-26 09:00 UTC. Do not share external notes until embargo lifted."

Mia: OK will schedule a quick QA push 5m after canary. QA-bot will post results.

QA-bot: Pre-run queued: smoke/kv_cache_smoke, long_seq_regression. Artifacts: will post link after run.

Lucy: Final RN for internal: "[INTERNAL] v3.0.0 -> staging 23:55 UTC. KV cache eviction improvements (p95 down ~100ms on short prompts). No API changes. Canary then staged rollout. Embargo external release until 2026-03-26 09:00 UTC. Owners: @owen, @mia, @lucy."

Owen: 44d Added rollback owner and commands to the runbook.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: T-15m to post internal announce. Canary checks: auto-evaluate 5xx and p95 at +5m intervals.

Lucy: Thumbs-up? If yes I'll post the internal announce at T-15m and pin it.

Jorge: 44d

Mia: 44d will run QA at +6m.

QA-bot: Smoke runs started at canary start. Posting results in 3m.

deploy-bot: Update: canary 5% started. Monitoring.

Lucy: (after canary): QA-bot shows smoke pass, long_seq looks stable, 5xx 0.03%, p95 down ~95ms. Proceeding to 25%. I'll post internal announce now.

Owen: Monitoring. Ready to rollback if needed.

Lucy: Internal announce posted and pinned. Embargo note included. Will unpin at 01:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Staged increase to 25% initiated @ +10m.

Lucy: Thanks team. If anyone wants the external RN draft DM me (holding until embargo lifts).
